story.title: About KNT Technology
paragraphs: KNT Technology Co., Ltd. is an enterprise software partner. We help organizations across manufacturing, logistics, retail and healthcare modernize how they operate — replacing manual work and disconnected systems with custom software built to enterprise standards.

Our belief is simple: technology should serve the business, not the other way around. That's why every engagement begins with business analysis — understanding your processes, constraints and goals before we design or build anything.

From ERP, warehouse and HR systems to system integration and business process automation, we deliver solutions that improve efficiency, reduce cost and give leadership the visibility to make better decisions — and we stay on as a long-term partner to help them evolve.
